data.name: Eleven v4
data.description: ElevenLabs' expressive text-to-speech model with audio tags for emotion and delivery, multilingual speech, and multi-speaker dialogue support. Accepts up to 10,000 characters per request and is billed per input character.

data.description: Sound effects generation from text prompts, billed per second of generated audio.

data.name: S2 Pro
data.description: Fish Audio S2 is the second-generation TTS model from Fish Audio. It's trained on over 10 million hours of audio across approximately 80 languages, and it introduces inline tag control: natural-language instructions embedded directly in your script at any position, giving you fine-grained direction over how speech is delivered at the word or phrase level.

data.name: Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS
data.description: Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS is Google's preview text-to-speech model for expressive narration and multi-speaker dialogue in 130 languages. It supports line-by-line style direction, regional accents, streaming synthesis, and consistent long-form audio. Prebuilt and curated voices, voice design, and voice replication help creators produce audiobooks, studio narration, games, and podcasts.

data.name: TTS-1
data.description: TTS is a model that converts text to natural sounding spoken text.

data.name: FLUX.2 [flex]
data.description:
FLUX.2 is a completely new base model trained for visual intelligence, not just pixel generation, setting a new standard for both image generation and image editing. With FLUX.2 models you can expect the highest quality, higher resolutions (up to 4MP), and new capabilities like multi-ref images. FLUX.2 [flex] supports customizable image generation and editing with adjustable steps and guidance. It's better at typography and text rendering. It supports up to 10 reference images (up to 14 MP total input).
This provider gives the option to change the moderation level for inputs and outputs. The control is under safety tolerance and is by default 2 on a range from 0 (more strict) through 6 (more permissive).

data.name: Qwen3-14B
data.description: Qwen3 is the latest generation of large language models in Qwen series, offering a comprehensive suite of dense and mixture-of-experts (MoE) models. Built upon extensive training, Qwen3 delivers groundbreaking advancements in reasoning, instruction-following, agent capabilities, and multilingual support
